items.quote:
Not the worst game by any means but really missed the mark.  The game is plagued with performance issues, I didn't encounter too many but only because I have a highend PC.

The story is completely forgettable, I couldn't bring myself to finish the game, maybe got 10-14 hours into it.  The entire game is just shoot the same 5 enemy types and then loot and move to a new area and rinse and repeat.  This is fun at first but gets boring very fast.  The writing is very poor and becomes cringe at times.  I cannot remember any character from the game right now.  Forgettable.

items.author: Fridgemuffin

items.quote: Wow. Im disappointed. Finishing this game was torture. But I still did it because Im a die hard fan. From a gamer since the NES system- this thing has serious issues. They spread themselves way too thin with the sheer size of this world. Studios these days need to realize one thing- when it comes to game sandboxes bigger is not always better. The weapon scaling and character leveling is way off. The guns are not fun at all. Not even the good ones. The drop rate of good guns is way too low. Even with all the keys they gave out. I got so many useless gold guns it really really pissed me off. A bunch of heavys that are useless because i like grenades better. The enemies feel thoughtless. I feel like Im killing the same handful of enemies over. And over. And over. Too much slogging around on this idiotic bike and not enough fast travel. The quests are stupid and most have crappy rewards so theres zero incentive to do them. I could go on. All in all this adds up to one seriously boring game. Awful. Its like nobody tested this hot garbage.
items.author: anesthesia

items.quote: Performance issues aside (I never actually had a single crash with Nvidia's driver version 581.15, just 1-second stutters when some in-game event being triggered) - this game is a sorry shell of previous BL games in terms of story writing. It feels severely "neutered", like it went through same filter as latest Saints Row game went, with much less "over-the-top" absurdity and instead much more bland "safe" joke attempts. Even the weapons have lost some of their unique quirkiness from previous games (no more shooting ship anchors out of rocket launchers, or guns screaming at you/talking to you) and instead became more... practical but much more boring at the same time. Very disappointing, though certainly not unexpected, considering this latest game was developed during the period of forced "sensitivity correctness" in US, which is what its writers/designers were constantly trying to focus on (the extremely cringe "Ready to Blow" side quest is a perfect example of it).

items.quote: Bad game design on a lot of missions leading to pointless deaths, tons of wasted time getting lost, etc. Many bugs. Controls are not great on a controller. Melee builds need you to tap R3 wtf lol. I can't view and equip guns I collect bug there's a bug that prevents inventories from populating. Lol. The waypoint system is barely functional. There are so many things that I have to spend so much time figuring out how to get to that I really shouldn't. When the game launched, damage was recursive and a large amount of things could do infinite damage which lasted months. There is a teammate that CONSTANTLY FLIES IN FRONT OF YOUR CROSSHAIRS AND FLOATS THERE. WHY IS THIS EVEN A THING.Also, end-game progress is no longer shared between characters. Physics is broken - you go to shoot something and before you can kill it, your quest enemy is yeeting over the horizon. Wastes time trying to find it, and messes with limited ammo types, aiming, and the entire fight for your life revive mechanic. Dumb burrito trophy. Forces your aim off what you're targeting when enemies group up. Pretty much a POS for a shooter.

items.quote:
Game is fun, but way way WAY too many bugs for a $70 game that's been out this long. Here we are almost December, and still way too many bugs. Legendary items **** for the most part. Villain was boring and two-dimensional. Endgame is boring. Gameplay is boring unless you're playing with a friend, but if you're in multiplayer, they're are even MORE bugs. items.author: TheGamesLetter

items.quote: Loot drops are garbage, no reason to kill high level enemies.. then you get barely any xp. Missions are not straightforward in the slightest, and require so much of you that you forget the story while you're trying to figure it out. You're basically just bumbling around a big beautiful map pointlessly. I understand that they wanted to change the drop rate after borderlands 3 (which I think was a mistake, But anyways) however they've taken it to a point where you don't have any reason to kill the big things.. they have an insane amount of health for no reason, and no reward. Thanks game, I really wanted to spend the last 5 minutes killing one enemy for a green weapon smh. The loot table is worse now than it has ever been, including in borderlands 1. The experience that you get from killing enemies is ridiculous, which makes leveling a tedious and unfulfilling experience. The skills that the characters have are lackluster at best, and lazy at worst. In borderlands 2, I could throw out turrets that literally exploded into a nuke, in borderlands 3, I could hop into a giant mech and absolutely destroy my surroundings... In this game? Here's my little pet, he's going to tickle you.. his name is trouble, but I think that's what I get into if I use this skill ‍♂️ this game needs serious rebalancing. I understand what they were trying to do, and I think that they're really onto something, this game has the potential to be beautiful, and the best one yet in the franchise.. but it needs a lot of work before that becomes a reality.

items.author: POWERTIL

items.quote: I’ll start with what’s good. The graphics are great, the physics are amazing, and the gameplay is the best in the series. This is the end of the good in this game. They made the decision to go to a full open world, and it leads to HALF the mission variety and enemy variety of previous games. You’ll fight the same 2 factions the entire game and that’s basically it, outside of the wildlife. The writing is abysmal, Amara for some reason tries to make her voice deeper and it sounds so cringe I can’t even describe it. The villain of the game known as the time keeper has 0 charm and doesn’t show up enough for you to truly build any sort of hate or drive to beat him, he’s just a generic evil guy. The location/ mission variety is about 25% of what it used to be. Instead of visiting dozens of unique areas there’s only 4, and they are all biomes that we’ve seen before. The characters are unlikable, and that goes for the vault hunters as well with the exception of Amon and Rafa. Later in the game some of the npc character's will die and you won’t even care. The story is a complete mess that really starts to not make sense at the end, finish the game and you’ll see what I mean. Almost none of the jokes land, this is the worst the humor has been in the entire series. Now here is the biggest complaint I have. In borderlands 3 they got rid of true/ultimate vault hunter mode and replaced it with the mayhem system, which basically no one liked or preferred over the bl2 true vault hunter mode. In bl4 they “ brought back “ ultimate vault hunter mode but the only similarity it shares with bl2 is the name. It’s basically bl3s mayhem mode with challenges to complete. I seriously do not understand how gearbox can be so tone def, it’s almost like they knew that we wanted the bl2 system back and they made the new “ ultimate vault hunter mode “ share the same name just to troll us. This completely murders the end game, the identify of borderlands is dead. Beyond cell shaded graphics and a randomized loot system this game has nothing that made us love borderlands and borderlands 2 so much. if ur a fan of this series, especially bl1 or bl2 just save yourself $70 and don’t even bother. Also im sure you’ve already heard about how bad the optimization is in this game on pc so i won’t even get into that. Its so bad, that it overshadows how bad this game really is. Don’t be fooled, this isn’t a good game that’s dealing with technical problems, this is a **** game that also runs like ****.
